simplified: Quilting: the 2x diamond seams and 2 x 2 tufts become three 2 px dusk tufts in a triangle and a lit centre band; no seam lines at 1x.
Piping and gill fringe: one plaster_warm row along the brim (lit to the left), one dusk_cool gill row either side of the neck shadow.
Eyes: the 2 x 2 eyes under a heavy lid become 1 x 2 ink eyes (no separate lid or brow); the cheeks are single berry texels and the mouth is dropped.
Stem fibres (plaster_cool streaks) are dropped: the stem is three plaster tones.
notes: Same design as the 2x final (option C): a wide light-dusk mat cap on a short pale stem, arm nubs below the brim, two earth feet; in E/W the face and the muzzle step move to the facing side and the far arm hides.
W is drawn, not mirrored: the light stays at the upper left (the lit cap edge and the lit stem side are on the left in every view).
Compared with Matt's 1x Bramble and Mossling: three tones a material plus the edge tone, eyes as solid ink, no texel noise.
